concerns.text: T016 is marked with [X] (Test status) but describes 'Implement VIF diagnostic computation' which is a core implementation requirement (FR-008). This misclassification leaves the actual implementation of the VIF logic without a corresponding unmarked implementation task, violating the requirement that every FR must have a concrete implementation deliverable.

FR-002 and Spec Assumptions mandate using TGA measurement uncertainty (±5°C to ±10°C) as sample weights. T020 implements training but lacks the logic to parse `temperature_precision` from metadata (T041/T042 are in Phase 7). T021 adds stratification but not weighting. The model training phase cannot satisfy FR-002 without the Phase 7 artifacts, creating a semantic weakening of the requirement.

T030 allows 'Internal Stratified Validation' (splitting training data) as a fallback for external validation. FR-006 and SC-003 explicitly require 'held-out experimental data from the literature' to assess OOD generalizability. Using the same training data for validation contradicts the OOD requirement, effectively weakening the success criterion to a standard CV check.

T009b implements 'title-token-overlap' validation against primary source citations for raw API data. Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) applies to citations in design docs, not raw data ingestion from APIs (NREL/MP) which do not contain academic citations. This task enforces a scope-violating constraint on the data pipeline, potentially blocking valid data acquisition.

T019 enforces a ≤6 hour runtime limit. The Spec's US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 explicitly requires the pipeline to complete within 4 hours. The task list fails to include a verification step for the stricter 4-hour target, silently relaxing the performance constraint.
